response.original_title: Kiss on the Shore by Moonlight
response.overview: A silent vampire film set in Glasgow, visually (re)animated by Gwen Hall and scored by dj peanut. Loosely adapted from passages of Jalal Toufic’s ‘Vampires: An Uneasy Essay on the Undead in Film’ and Edvard Munch’s limerent paintings, the film crudely inserts a sultry digital character into live-action footage in an exploration of personal duality set to a dark experimental soundtrack.
response.tagline: A silent vampire film set in Glasgow
